data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant claim reserved in Reinsurance to Close following the earthquake; claim reserved in Yen (Yen 686m) and reserved in Yen which has depreciated against sterling reducing the Sterling loss (matched by loss on Yen cash hedge).
Reserve last year was some GBP 4m; claim was settled at less than this, at GBP 1.7m (favourable development / release).
Additional loss experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m (adverse impact).
A recent reserve of GBP 1.4m was established for a possible material damage loss in China (strengthening/reserving).

named_events.loss_description: Claim reserved in Yen (Yen 686m); reserved in Yen which has depreciated against sterling reducing the Sterling loss, matched by a loss on Yen cash held to hedge against the claim.
Claim settled at GBP 1.7m (lower than prior reserve of ~GBP 4m).
Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m for the loss.
Established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1176 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.487m and disclosed a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 9.5m in 2014. The release reflects generally favourable claims development and lower-than-expected settlements on certain prior events (notably a South African medical isotope plant claim which settled below prior reserves). Offsetting movements included specific losses and recent reserves (for example Urenco in the UK and a material damage exposure in China) and an outstanding Reinsurance-to-Close nuclear claim reserved in Yen for Hamaoka. Overall the net prior year movement is a material release driven by favourable developments across older years.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).
The 2012 underwriting year has performed well, reflecting low loss experience and the decision not to buy reinsurance for the Syndicate.
The reserve last year was some GBP 4m; although the claim was settled at less than this, at GBP 1.7m.
An additional loss was experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.
The Syndicate has also established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from the narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 9.5m; the note is taken as a gross figure (no separate insurance liabilities column presented). Some event amounts are given in foreign currency (Yen 686m) and were not converted. No gross claims development triangle was present in the extracts; LOB-specific prior year movements are not provided in the report so lob_movements are omitted.
